summary:
Fixer round for Phase 1 ("every number right, plus the demo blockers") on branch claude/accuracy, starting from 72de370. Four commits, not pushed. All checks pass on the final commit 0a60f89. Every rule that every quote must keep holds on 10,000 random quotes (0 violations on all 8). Both golden sets have 0 violations. Every value change has a ledger entry and a test that fails before the change and passes after.

THE PLANNED REPORT.MD WAS NOT WRITTEN. This environment refuses report .md files written by a subagent, so the report text is in this summary. report.json was written: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/e9b02a42-cb4a-5aa1-bf7b-e82e27ad6b23/scratchpad/accuracy/report/report.json. It lists every golden difference with its estimate, the old and new value, the ledger IDs and the owner decision behind it. All 164 differences are explained; none is left unexplained. The generator is make_report.py in the same folder.

- Live golden set: 78 real estimates, exported read-only, priced with the live rows after the new migration.
  - Violations 829 -> 0.

- Synthetic golden set: 62 estimates.

It ignores the insulation already in the wall, re-derives R from a full-cavity bag count, and does not allow the one whole bag a tiny area needs. The app's own rules hold on all of those inputs.

EVERY SYNTHETIC TOTAL THAT MOVED (none moved in the live set)
- Walls with no depth now price as a 2x4 (L18, OD5): open-cell fills 3.5 in to R-13 instead of 5.4 in to R-20.

  - Walls 650, difficult: Better $2,810 -> $2,005.

  - Attic + walls 900 + rim 160: Better $8,690 -> $7,670. Good $4,785 -> $4,820 (dense-pack bags L20, an R-11 batt that fits L22).
- Dense-pack bag count (L20, OD7):

  - S1-F9 walls 2,200, 2x4: Good $2,090 -> $3,070.

- Existing insulation counts (L19, OD5): S1-F5 walls with 2 in of cellulose already in them: Better $2,245 -> $1,500, Best $3,115 -> $2,295.
- Whole dollars (L5, L3, OD4, OD3): S1-F1 Good $4,321.50 -> $4,322, with a Price adjustment line.
- Dense-pack walls (OD7) are the only change that raises prices. A wall is blown dense, so a 25 lb bag covers 35 sq ft of 2x4 wall (Greenfiber SANCTUARY card INS765), not the attic coverage.
- Sent and signed quotes keep their stored items, prices, dates and PDFs (hard rule 2). Re-pricing them here shows what the same estimate would show if quoted again today.

apiNotes:
- Engine (lib/pricing/engine.ts):
  - priceEstimate(input, snapshot, coeffs, opts?: { showAll?: boolean }) hides duplicates and options that do not step up unless showAll is set. Each hidden option gets an 'option_hidden' warning.

- lib/pricing/policy.ts:
  - canSendQuote(role, options, settings, approvals = []) returns PolicyProblem objects {tier, kind, message, price?, modelPrice?}.
  - Also exports floorPrice, estimatorRange and the PriceApproval type.
- lib/quotes/model.ts: counterQuoteNumber(prefix, year, counter, version), quoteNumberBase, businessYear, quoteValidUntil, legacyQuoteNumber; buildQuoteDocument now takes quoteNumber and consent.
- lib/quotes/profile.ts: PROFILE_FIELDS, businessProfileGaps(rows), profileGapsSentence, newEstimateDefaults(rows).
- lib/quotes/approvals.ts: loadApprovals, approvedPrices, latestByTier.
- lib/quotes/consent.ts: esignConsent(state), consentFor(doc).
- lib/field/sendChecks.ts: sendChecks({...}) returns SendCheck objects {id, ok, label, fix?: {label, target: FixTarget}, approval?}.

- lib/server/auth.ts:
  - getSessionState() returns 'ok' | 'signed_out' | 'unreachable'.
  - requireRole sends an unreachable session to /unreachable?next=…; authorize answers 503 when unreachable.
  - proxy.ts sets the x-koala-path header.
- New API routes: /api/approvals (GET, POST) and /api/approvals/[id] (PATCH).
